marketScope: Curated market-signal matrix and tracked Commander deck printings; not the complete MTG singles universe.
methodology: Signals compare the current normalized MTGJSON paper price with the prior local daily snapshot. A flat first observation establishes a baseline rather than fabricating movement.

categories.label: Percentage gainers
categories.criteria: Positive percentage change; previous and current price at least $1.00.

categories.label: Percentage decliners
categories.criteria: Negative percentage change; previous and current price at least $1.00.

categories.label: Dollar gainers
categories.criteria: Positive absolute price change of at least $1.00.

categories.label: Dollar decliners
categories.criteria: Negative absolute price change of at least $1.00.

categories.label: Budget breakouts
categories.criteria: Current price $1.00–$10.00; rise at least $0.25 and 10.00%.
